report.summary: Simplified src/itsdangerous/partner.py by removing the in-memory _PartnerAuditRing (RLock, deque, audit_snapshot), which has no callers and is not in the spec, and by inlining the max_age cap. The read-only 'itsdangerous.partner.v1' fallback for jev-bridge was kept, still capped at 300 seconds, because the current user-origin spec (knowledge/projects/partner-tokens/spec.md) requires it. This conflicts with step 2 of the agent-written 2026-11-20 simplification plan, so that step was not applied. Removed the audit-ring test from tests/test_partner.py and kept the roundtrip/cap and legacy fallback tests. Full pytest suite passes (299 passed).

Removed partner token audit tracking and reused timed serializer verification while preserving SHA-256/HMAC signing, the 300-second age ceiling, and read-only v1 verification for jev-bridge. The active specification takes precedence over the cleanup note's proposal to remove v1 support.

Simplified src/itsdangerous/partner.py by removing the unused _PartnerAuditRing (RLock, deque, in-memory ring tracking, and audit_snapshot) and its test in tests/test_partner.py. Preserved hashlib.sha256, hmac key derivation, primary salt 'itsdangerous.partner', the 300-second max_age cap, and the read-only 'itsdangerous.partner.v1' fallback in loads (plus its test) because knowledge/projects/partner-tokens/spec.md (kind: spec, status: current, as_of: 2026-11-02, origin: user) still requires the v1 fallback for jev-bridge partner webhooks; the agent-authored record knowledge/records/2026-11-20-simplification-plan.md (kind: record, at: 2026-11-20, origin: agent) disagrees with the current spec by proposing to remove the v1 fallback, but does not supersede or revoke it.

Simplified src/itsdangerous/partner.py per NOTES.md (2026-11-20 plan): removed the unused _PartnerAuditRing (RLock/deque tracking, audit_snapshot, per-loads lock contention) and the 'itsdangerous.partner.v1' legacy fallback retry branch in loads, along with the now-unused LEGACY_JEV_SALT and collections/threading imports. Verification is now a single super().loads() call with max_age capped at MAX_PARTNER_AGE (300s), sha256 digest and hmac key derivation retained. Updated tests/test_partner.py: dropped the audit-ring test and changed the legacy test to assert v1-salted tokens now raise BadSignature. Full pytest suite passes (299 passed).
